subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt all five memory role slots and per-agent overrides as a permanent public plugin/config contract?
rationale: The concrete status-path defect is mechanically repairable, but the PR also creates durable config keys, defaults, plugin hook semantics, migration behavior, and external plugin compatibility obligations that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor all five roles
options.body: Accept the complete role model after the current blocker, exact-head upgrade proof, and Control UI proof are resolved.

options.title: Land a narrower role set
options.body: Keep only roles with complete current invocation protocols and defer dreaming, compaction, or user modeling to focused follow-ups.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Retain the current recall owner and use narrower companion-plugin or hook seams until the permanent role model is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor all five roles
recommendation.body: Accept the complete role model after the current blocker, exact-head upgrade proof, and Control UI proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged selected-slot dreaming work is the strongest history-based ownership signal for deciding how dreaming ownership should evolve within the broader role contract.
